svg.title: Open ETF Agent six-layer module map
svg.desc: L1 Inputs & triggers: CLI · Research Project · Schedule. Local single-user; no recurring or resident scheduler; L2 Identity, session & context: Session · Context · Memory · Skill · Conversation. Memory is not original evidence or new authority; L3 Agent decisions & execution: Runtime · Gateway · Worker · Child · Admission. Completion is not accuracy; unknown requests retained; L4 Tools & domain capabilities: Tools · MCP · Plugin · Result · Knowledge · Web / PDF. Static Web / PDF text, not live financial data; L5 Publication & delivery: Report · Artifact · Publication · Review. Saving, publication and quality are separate claims; L6 User interfaces: CLI · Loopback Reader. Not a full Web workspace; no browser qualification

g.text: Open ETF Agent · v0.30.0
Six responsibilities · implementation ≠ qualification
L1 · Inputs & triggers
CLI · Research Project · Schedule
Project submission, finite once schedules, explicit continuation
Local single-user; no recurring or resident scheduler
L2 · Identity, session & context
Session · Context · Memory · Skill · Conversation
Original identity, bounded context, explicit memory
Memory is not original evidence or new authority
L3 · Agent decisions & execution
Runtime · Gateway · Worker · Child · Admission
Resume, shared budgets, independent Child cancellation
Completion is not accuracy; unknown requests retained
L4 · Tools & domain capabilities
Tools · MCP · Plugin · Result · Knowledge · Web / PDF
Read originals, reread sources, bounded calculations
Static Web / PDF text, not live financial data
L5 · Publication & delivery
Report · Artifact · Publication · Review
Immutable revisions, accepted body, advisory review
Saving, publication and quality are separate claims
L6 · User interfaces
CLI · Loopback Reader
CLI operations, local report and attachment readback
Not a full Web workspace; no browser qualification
Responsibilities overlap; not six mandatory sequential services.
